quarterly_data.signal: New preclinical data for EVX-04, the off-the-shelf therapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia (AML), to be presented in a poster at the EHA 2026 Congress: EVX-04 is completely expressed and secreted in human cells, all of its ERV antigens drive specific immune responses in mice (in vivo) and human cells (in vitro) across different human immune profiles, and the vaccine-induced immune cells mediate targeted cell-killing. From five million ERV antigen fragments discovered, AI-Immunology selected the 16 included in EVX-04, all of which elicit a specific immune response, and EVX-04 prevents tumor growth in preclinical tumor models. CSO & COO: the company is preparing the regulatory filing for clinical testing in parallel.
quarterly_data.figure: five million ERV fragments discovered; 16 selected
